_about: Loop-driver smoke suite: drives the harness's own loop consumer (50-drivers.md -> loop) against the harness's distractor MCP server as the system under test, through the recorder, on OpenRouter. Proves the instrument (calibration probe, strict routing, served-provider recording, exact S7 surface check, sessions/crowding, cost recording), never a server -- nothing here is a measurement worth scoring. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY in the environment. Run: `uv run mcp-e2e run --manifest examples/smoke/loop-prompts.json --budget-usd 0.05`. Spend is on the order of a tenth of a cent (measured 2026-09-18: $0.0008 for the three cells).
_portability: transport.command is plain `python3`, as in prompts.json: resolves to the project venv's interpreter under `uv run`.

loop-smoke-pinned._: pinned open-weight floor model, fresh, full surface: proves the probe gate, the pin's strict routing, per-request served-provider recording, and the exact wire-surface check

loop-smoke-isolation-unpinned._: unpinned, list-valued surface: proves the unpinned reproducibility mark on every artifact and the proxy-enforced surface on the wire

loop-smoke-crowded._: crowded context: proves the session mechanics (pre-turn then scored turn in one conversation), the distractor beside the SUT on the wire, and the separate pre-turn trace

crowding.collision_review: 2026-09-18 (smoke only): NOT a disjointness attestation -- this suite's SUT deliberately IS the distractor content. Acceptable only because this suite smoke-tests the instrument and its results are never scored.

checks.description: every tool response carries typed content

prompts.title: list the inbox
prompts.prompt: Using the notes_sut server, tell me which notes are still unfiled: list their ids and titles.
prompts.grounding: the distractor procedure defines 12 notes (crowding.py); the crowded cell files four first
prompts.pass: lists the unfiled notes from a tool result
prompts.fail: invents notes or answers without calling a tool
prompts._why_named: Smoke only: the crowded cell registers the distractor beside a SUT that serves the same tools, so the prompt names the SUT to keep the scored turn's trace on the instrument under test. A real suite never needs this: its server's domain is disjoint from the crowding procedure by attestation.

prompts.title: read one note
prompts.prompt: Read note n03 and tell me what it says.
prompts.grounding: note n03 is the fire drill note (crowding.py)
prompts.pass: quotes the fire drill note from the read_note result
prompts.fail: answers without the tool or invents content
